title: Vanguard Warden (Aegis Dynamics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Vanguard Warden is a long-range heavy fighter from Aegis Dynamics in Star Citizen. The pilot sits in the nose, a second crew member works the rear turret, and there is living space behind for long patrols. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Vanguard Warden: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Vanguard Warden's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (five)
controls.text: The Vanguard Warden has five guns that the pilot fires. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (twelve missiles)
controls.text: Twelve missiles hang in the Vanguard Warden's racks. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Vanguard Warden: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Vanguard Warden besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Rear turret
controls.text: One turret at the back for the second crew member. Each gunner sits in a turret of their own.
controls.context: A turret seat has its own controls: there the right stick aims the turret instead of steering the ship.

controls.name: Living space
controls.text: Beds behind the cockpit let the crew rest on long patrols.
controls.context: Long trips far from stations are possible because the crew can sleep and stay aboard.
